<function name="GetModelMatrix" parent="cam" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>Returns a copy of the model matrix that is at the top of the stack.
	<note>Editing the matrix **will not** edit the current view. To do so, you will have to use <page>cam.PushModelMatrix</page>.</note>
	</description>
	<realm>Client</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="VMatrix">The currently active model matrix.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
